title: Plant Return Schedule for the Crop Input Purchasing Accounts
content:
Product comes back to the agronomy plant on the terms the member's programme of Crop Input Purchasing Accounts carries. This schedule fixes, programme by programme, the days a return is open for, the restocking charge on an accepted return, the input classes that may come back at all, the day in the season after which seed no longer comes back, and whether crop protection product must be unopened.

| Programme | Return window (calendar days) | Restocking charge (percent of invoiced value) | Input classes accepted back | Seed cutoff | Crop protection unopened only |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Cash Purchase Account | 14 | 15 | seed; dry fertilizer; crop protection | 15 June | yes |
| Standard 30-Day Charge Account | 14 | 15 | seed; dry fertilizer; crop protection | 15 June | yes |
| Seasonal Terms Crop Input Account | 21 | 12 | seed; dry fertilizer; liquid fertilizer; crop protection | 15 June | yes |
| Early Pay Prepay Program Account | 21 | 12 | seed; dry fertilizer; liquid fertilizer; crop protection | 15 June | yes |
| Full Acre Input Financing Account | 30 | 10 | seed; dry fertilizer; liquid fertilizer; crop protection; micronutrients | 15 June | yes |
| Precision Partner Input Program Account | 30 | 8 | seed; dry fertilizer; liquid fertilizer; crop protection; micronutrients; seed treatment | 30 June | yes |

### How the schedule reads

The return window is counted in whole calendar days from the delivery date on the ticket the product left on. The restocking charge is stated as a percentage of the invoiced value of what comes back, and falls as the programme rises: 15 percent on the two entry programmes, 12 percent on the Seasonal Terms and Early Pay programmes, 10 percent on the Full Acre Input Financing Account and 8 percent on the Precision Partner Input Program Account.

An input class that does not appear in a programme's column does not come back on that programme at all. Seed comes back only up to the seed cutoff shown: 15 June on every programme of Crop Input Purchasing Accounts except the Precision Partner Input Program Account, where it is 30 June. Crop protection product is accepted back unopened and in its original packaging on every programme.

### Points of judgement

**A member on the Standard 30-Day Charge Account asks about returning micronutrients.** That class is not among the classes that programme accepts back.

**A member on the Full Acre Input Financing Account asks how long they have.** The window is 30 calendar days from the delivery date on the ticket, and the restocking charge on what is accepted is 10 percent of the invoiced value.
